assumptions_challenged: SGL-001 source-cell materials (MCB/WCB) are produced, characterized, and suitable for scale-up.
Orthogonal intact-EV QC assays for SGL-001 (with reported LLOQ, specificity, precision) have been developed and validated fit-for-purpose.
A stability-indicating, mechanism-linked potency assay correlated to an in vivo PD endpoint exists for SGL-001.
Reproducible release, stability, and potency comparability across ≥3 representative GMP-like batches has been demonstrated for SGL-001.
Rodent intranasal biodistribution data for SGL-001 alone are sufficient to predict intact-EV CNS exposure in larger species without matched intact-EV assays and bridging studies.
falsification_conditions: Provision of MCB/WCB generation records and characterization reports (identity, purity, adventitious agent testing) demonstrating defined source-cell materials.
Validated orthogonal intact-EV assay reports for SGL-001 with documented LLOQ, specificity, precision, and demonstrated ability to separate vesicular from non-vesicular signals.
Report of a stability-indicating, mechanism-relevant potency assay for SGL-001 with correlation to an in vivo PD endpoint.

Release, stability, and potency data from ≥3 representative GMP-like production runs showing lot-to-lot comparability for defined CQAs (particle counts/distribution, marker panels, potency), with associated batch records and SOPs.
GLP or GLP-like large-animal intranasal biodistribution study using the validated intact-EV assays on lot-matched material, showing reproducible intact-EV CNS exposure that bridges from rodent data.
strongest_objection: There is no program-specific CMC/analytics or validated intact-EV assay data in the supplied evidence set to demonstrate that SGL-001 meets the gating criteria required to attribute in vivo signal to intact EVs or to ensure lot-to-lot comparability; therefore the program should not advance into cross-species intact-EV delivery and PK/PD testing until those deliverables are provided and reviewed.
